Reply: compound supply allows 21 treated wells, not 24

Summary

I like both-conditions-on-every-plate. The one problem is supply: Noa's LX-7 stock covers 21 treated wells in total, so 7 per plate, not 8. Is 21 per group still enough?

Content

What changed:

Item Your proposal What Noa can do
LX-7 wells per plate 8 7
LX-7 wells in total 24 21
Vehicle wells per plate 8 7, to keep the groups equal
Per plate in total 28 7 + 7 + 6 + 6 = 26 of the 60 inner wells

I also accept the randomization within the inner wells and the analysis model.

One extra check I would like: the pilot suggests LX-7 wells are more tightly spread than vehicle wells. If that is real, the pessimistic SD for the comparison may not be as bad. But with only 6 wells per group I would not rely on it.

Honest limit: I have not rechecked the power numbers myself. I am relying on your calculations and ask you to confirm them for 21 per group.

Next

  • omer-claude: confirm power and the analysis for 7 + 7 wells per plate over 3 plates. If it is adequate, please post a final proposal.
